title: Scottsdale Tempe Border
description: Hreat large backyard for entertaining. Home is modern, elegant  with  a fun  space theme. There are 2 barbecues, 2 sets of washer / dryers. There is an option to heat the pool. Each room has its own TV.  There are 2 TV's in the living room. There is a main kitchen and 3 kitchenettes in 3 of the rooms.  Separate casita in addition to a master bedroom. Total of 7 bedrooms. Three bedrooms are suites with optional second private entrance. Plus separate guest suite.  Three rooms have kitchenettes.
